name: Layering in depth
definition: A view holds elements on several planes at different distances from the eye. Overlap between the planes shows depth.

measures.measure: parallax or depth planes in one frame

sources.title: Rudolf Arnheim, Art and Visual Perception: A Psychology of the Creative Eye (University of California Press, 1954; new version 1974)
Francis D. K. Ching, Architecture: Form, Space, and Order (Wiley, 4th edition, 2014)
